reviews.text:
Laura, the owner of K9 Off Leash, has been wonderful to work with. From the moment I shared the challenges I was experiencing with my dog, she was attentive, followed up consistently, and matched me with the trainer who was the best fit for our situation.

My dog had developed a strong aversion to being touched by anyone but me, making it important to address the behavior for everyone’s safety. Unlike trainers who rely primarily on obedience training to manage aggression, our trainer Gary specializes in addressing the root of aggressive behavior.

Gary came to my home, evaluated my dog while wearing a bite suit, developed a thoughtful training plan, and worked systematically to change the behavior. Not only did he resolve the issue, but he also helped my dog become comfortable with being petted again. The transformation was remarkable in just five sessions.

Gary was always punctual, communicated exceptionally well, and provided clear homework after each session so we could continue making progress between visits. I am incredibly grateful for his expertise and would highly recommend both Gary and K9 Off Leash to anyone dealing with serious behavioral challenges.

Great experience! I went out of town for 2 weeks and decided to do boarding and training for my 1 year old retriever mix. He learned a ton and he honestly loved it. He doesn’t jump nearly as much when meeting people and walks great on leash now. The foundation he learned will only continue to be built thanks to K9 Off Leash doing things the right way.

We are over the moon with the behavioral changes in our Belgian Malinois, Cash! He is a more disciplined dog in so many ways - he can handle dog parks, community walks, pet stores and even the beach - without any worries or concerns about his behavior. We were taught how to communicate with Cash to provide structure and routines to his walks. Thank you!!

I had a fantastic experience with K9 Off Leash in Miami. The team is extremely knowledgeable, professional, and clearly passionate about what they do. They took the time to really understand both my dog and my specific needs, and the results exceeded my expectations.

My dog Marley went through several months of training with them, and the transformation was remarkable. The training was not only effective but also done in a thoughtful and responsible way that builds trust and confidence in the dog. Marley is now calm, responsive, and able to navigate complex environments—including busy public places and travel situations—with ease.

What impressed me most was their level of dedication and communication throughout the process. They truly care about the dogs they work with and the people they are helping.

I would highly recommend K9 Off Leash to anyone looking for high-quality professional dog training in Miami.

We highly recommend K9 Off Leash (K9OL).  We recently rescued a young adult dog and wanted assistance with basic and advanced training. We live in a high rise building in Miami.  K9OL offered flexible plans.  We started with a board and train.  Our rescue is a sweet dog with good raw materials but limited basic training (recall, walking, distraction avoidance, dog manners), and came back a well trained dog that balanced her personality and energy with strong manners and obedience.  This segment ended with three days of local training in our building, focused on building manners and making sure we understood how to reinforce and build upon her training.  We discussed with Laura and decided to proceed with a second segment oriented around more advanced training for service and therapy dogs.  Similar to the first segment, the results were fantastic and we concluded by solidifying this training in public situations like airports as well as semi private settings like sporting events where she learned to rest quietly while we were active.  Throughout the process we interacted frequently with Laura as well as our dog’s trainer.  What was noteworthy for us beyond the fantastic results was how much our dog respected and adored her trainer. The K9OL process was seamless and a perfect fit for our family!
Thanks to Laura and Juan Carlos, our 2 year old, newly adopted Springer who arrived to us untrained became a model citizen!

Amazing boarding and training experience. Best place in town for obedience training and superb boarding with trained dog handlers in charge of walks. Highly recommend for any and all dog training and boarding needs!

We had an incredible experience with K9 off leash in North Miami Beach, Florida. They trained our Sheepadoo , Leia, to be a fully capable Service dog. The results have truly exceeded our expectations.
Our trainer provided personalized one-on-one training that made all the difference. Leia received real world exposure, which included escalator training at Brickell city Center, and airport training at Miami International Airport, which has been invaluable in our travels.
We also use their Boarding services, where Leia was treated like family.
Today, wherever we go, people constantly compliment her excellent behavior and calm demeanor. The training she received was both professional and compassionate.
I highly recommend K9 off leash for anyone looking for an exceptional service dog or obedience training. Thank you for helping Leia become the amazing companion she is with us today.
Guy
Great service! Very professional and kind.

We saw significant improvement in my 10 month old aussiedoodle. She now listens to commands and is much better behaved. She did the 4 week board and train. When she first got home she was still having some issues. They offered to take her back for 2 weeks which was really a game changer for my dog. The main trainer that worked with her is great. He has a gentle but authoritative approach. My dog loves him so much and listens perfectly to all his commands. We are still working on incorporating all of the training at home, but overall we're happy with her progress.

Top-of-the-line dog training facility - friendly staff, amazing service,  I’ve recommended all my friends to take their dogs to k-9off Leash for training - top-notch!  A must!! They don’t disappoint!! 👍🏻👍🏻

"This is the worst place to train your dog here in Miami."

Before finding K9 Off Leash Miami, we were convinced our 1.5-year-old Bernedoodle might be part dolphin. If there was a body of water—even a mildly suspicious puddle—she was in it. We’d spent thousands on in-home training trying to get her to heel, come when called, and most importantly, resist cannonballing into pools, oceans, lakes…you name it.

Enter Laura and her team.

After four weeks in the board and train program, our Piper came home with her same sweet, quirky personality, but now she actually listens (the E-Collar is essential to reinforcing the training). Like, really listens. I can walk her calmly at heel without her trying to tackle every lizard, squirrel, or rogue leaf in her path. She comes when called (even with distractions!), and best of all, she can chill by the pool with the kids swimming, and not treat it like her personal splash zone.

Laura and her trainers clearly love what they do, and it shows. We were super nervous when Piper left for the program (missed her so much) and of course, cautious based on past in home fails, but we are beyond impressed with the results and so grateful to finally feel like we’re in sync with our dog. Highly recommend—unless you’re really into wet paw prints on your furniture or a dog that will chase a squirrel into ongoing traffic. 😉

We cannot wait to see your new place!
The impecable cleanliness and order along side the friendly welcome you and your staff receive us with, make it a pleasure to drop off and pick up our Slash.

We are so happy with K9 Off Leash that you can be sure we will recommend you and trust our baby with you again if she is welcome.
We are more than thrilled to have found you. We count it as a blessing.
You are doing a pawsome job.
Un abrazo
Christiane and Slash

Trainers are wonderful! My puppy learned so much during her 4 weeks at board and train. Completely transformed and a happy happy puppy! Don’t wait to get your dog in with these trainers—you won’t regret it!

K9 Off Leash is the real deal. Their professionalism, attention to detail, and passion for what they do are unmatched. From day one, you can tell this team genuinely cares about delivering results and building trust. The trainers are knowledgeable, friendly, and completely dialed in... they make the process smooth, clear, and effective. It’s rare to find a company that lives up to the hype, but K9 Off Leash goes above and beyond.

We left Chris with Shai, our 6 month old rottweiler, for a two week board and train.  Tbh, I was sceptical about what would be achieved in two weeks.  When we got her back, we were blown away with her improvement - her obedience was next level.  Additionally, over the past few weeks I've noticed my stress levels have decreased because she listens, no longer having to repeat myself and raise my voice.  Ecollar training is the way to go and hats off to Chis for getting her to where she is in 2 weeks!

If you are considering dog training, and I mean REAL dog training, then you MUST use K9 Off Leash!  My dog has never been so obedient... it's like he's had a personality transplant.  And their training methods are humane, unlike a lot of other so-called "trainers" I've researched.  Laura was a joy to work with, she explained the whole process in detail (which gave me considerable peace of mind), and absolutely delivered on everything she promised.  While I encourage you to do your research, I can tell you that you really don't need to go anywhere else if you're serious about having your dog trained.  Thanks K9 Off Leash!!!
Loved working with k-9 off leash! Our dog was aggressive towards people entering our home + bad working with a stroller. After 5 sessions she’s made a big turnaround.

Having K9 Off Leash train my two dogs (both big dogs) was the best decision! Laura and her trainers are the best, and they really love what they do. It's finally a joy to take my dogs out for walks... they are so well behaved now. Thank you!

I can't speak highly enough of K9 Off Leash for Training. Sending my 3-4 month-old husky to their board and train program was the best decision I could have made. They worked wonders with his training. He's socialized, understands and follows basic commands, and he's already walking off leash at such a young age. Their expertise and dedication truly shine through in the results they achieve. I couldn't be happier with the progress my puppy has made, thanks to K9 Off Leash for Training.
